scope: Seven bounded CPU parametric-reliability operations,partial JMP19.2 numerical coverage; not full parametric survival/reliability growth/RBD equivalence.
integration_status: Parent pubmod/publicexecute routes enabled;11focusedtests passed. NativeSQL validation belongs to parent.

common_contract.data: Finite rectangular nonempty numeric data,<=100000rows,<=1024columns,<=1000000cells. AFT uses<=16covariates and more observations than parameters.
common_contract.AFT_parameters: coefficients are original-unit intercept+slopes. standard_errors,z,p,CI/covariance append log_sigma as final parameter only for Weibull/lognormal. Exponential log_sigma0is fixed and not counted as estimated.
common_contract.numerical_limits: AFT actual likelihood/derivative evaluation budget200000000nominal n*d*d units; max1000iterations and50line-searchtrials; log_sigma in[-30,30]. Identifiability checks use positive-definite observed information with relative pivot1e-12.
common_contract.inference: Unpenalized observed-information95%Wald asymptotics; penalized curvature has no calibrated p/CI/AIC/BIC. Error on zero events,unidentified design/shape or exhausted iterations.
common_contract.normal_tails: Incomplete gamma for ordinary tails; Laplace continued fraction for positive z>=8 retains inverse-Mills derivative without cancellation.
common_contract.nulls: Nonrepresentable positive lifetime quantile/eta or NHPP infinity may be null; log-scale quantities remain available. No invalid JSON nonfinite tokens.

operations.data: 0..16numeric features followed by positive lifetime and event1/exact or0/right-censored; intercept-only rows[time,event]supported; observations>estimatedparameters.
args: ridge:0..1e12,default0; penaltylambda/2 times sum squared population-standardized slopes
operations.estimator: Full likelihood product of failure densities and censor survival probabilities. Log-time location=intercept+linear covariate effects. Exponential has SEV scale1; Weibull has common SEV scale sigma=1/shape; lognormal has common normal log-time sigma. Analytic score and observed information; BFGS inverse-curvature updates and Armijo line search. Original-unit coefficients/covariance and95%Wald intervals when unpenalized. With penalized slopes,curvature SEs remain descriptive,p-values/CI/AIC/BIC are null. Search log_sigma bounded[-30,30]; no false convergence or pseudoinverse.
operations.known_value: Finite identified right-censored MLE; exponential reduces to total exposure/failures in an intercept-only model.

operations.data: Same p feature columns as fit plus one query column. Query is nonnegative time for mode0 or probability strictly in(0,1)for mode1.
args: then unchanged predict_parameters from an AFT fit; savedvectorlength5+4p
operations.estimator: Reuse [distribution0exp/1Weibull/2lognormal,p,log_time_reference,log_sigma,centered_intercept,feature_origins(p),mean_offsets(p),population_scales(p),standardized_slopes(p)]. Feature centering uses origin and separate offset,with no query-driven refitting. Survival and lognormal quantiles use stable normal tails; nonrepresentable positive quantile is null while finite log_time_quantile is retained.

operations.description: Single-system time-truncated power NHPP MLE: scalar exact recurrence times; [observation_end].
operations.data: At least2positive exact event times,each<=positive observation end; all events at end is unidentified.
operations.estimator: Cumulative mean Lambda(t)=(t/eta)^shape. MLE shape=n/sum(log(T/t_i)),log_eta=log(T)-log(n)/shape. Ordered-event process loglik=sum(log intensity(t_i))-Lambda(T). Observed information for[log Lambda(T),log shape]isdiag(n,n),with delta-method shape/logeta SEs and95%log-Wald shape interval.

operations.description: Power NHPP cumulative/intensity prediction: nonnegative scalar times; [shape,log_eta].
operations.estimator: Lambda(t)=(t/eta)^shape,intensity=shape*Lambda(t)/t. At t0,cumulative0 and intensity0/1eta/infinite for shape>1/=1/<1 respectively; infinite/nonrepresentable values are null,and finite log cumulative mean is retained.

operations.description: Independent reliability blocks: component probability rows; [structure0series/1parallel/2kofn,k_if2].
operations.data: Each row defines one block from component success probabilities in[0,1]. Component probabilities may differ.
operations.estimator: Series product(p_i); parallel1-product(1-p_i)with stable log1p/expm1; k-of-n exact Poisson-binomial count recursion for nonidentical independent components. Returns block success and expected working-component count.
